target_customer: Growth and marketing teams at B2B, B2C, D2C and e-commerce brands wanting visibility in AI assistants
problem: Brands do not know how ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity describe or recommend them and cannot easily improve it.
business_model: SaaS subscription with a free plan and four published tiers (per company site)
product_category: Generative engine optimization (GEO) / AI search visibility

technical_complexity.rationale: Today's product (prompt and citation tracking across LLM answers, content generation) is mostly API orchestration and data pipelines; what the 2022 product was is unknown.

defensibility.rationale: Many GEO tools exist now and queries to LLMs are easy to replicate; no data or network moat is evidenced.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: In 2022 the AI-visibility category did not exist; SEO suites later added AI visibility features, but no dated source was gathered, so no outcome is recorded.

market_need_then: Unknown for the 2022 product. Current demand: customer case studies on the company site and a Maruti Suzuki incubation selection in June 2026.

branding.domain_note: Uses siftly.ai; whether an exact .com was obtained is not stated.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, outcome-focused: 'Your buyers ask AI first. Be the answer.'

brand_strength.rationale: Plain wordmark and tagline, 4.8 G2 rating claimed on its own site; no press about the brand itself.

pivots.why: Only an aggregator (happenstance.ai) links Siftly to a prior Airdot name; unconfirmed, so left undated.

outcome_analysis: Siftly joined YC in Winter 2022 and is still listed Active, with a small team. Its current GEO product fits a fast-growing 2025-2026 category, and it was one of five startups picked for Maruti Suzuki's incubation program in June 2026. Its early history, funding and traction are not documented in reliable sources, so whether it succeeded is unproven; it is alive and finding customers on the evidence available.
notes: Unverified (single aggregator, extruct.ai): $500K pre-seed dated 2022-03-29 from TDV Partners and Y Combinator; PitchBook snippet lists Maruti Suzuki Innovation as an investor; not recorded as a round. Site footers list two legal entities, Tingo Tech, Inc. and Siftly, Inc. No dated 2022 competitor evidence found. Airdot-to-Siftly pivot and founder titles rest on aggregator data.
